LIVE_CHAT_RULES.DESCRIPTION: How long an agent has to reply before a waiting customer counts as overdue, and how much time the extend action buys. Set a default for the account and override it for any project.

FORM.TITLE: Live chat rule
FORM.DESC: These values drive the countdown shown on every waiting conversation.

REPLY_TIMEOUT.LABEL: Reply within (minutes)
REPLY_TIMEOUT.HELP: Time an agent has to reply before the conversation counts as overdue. The countdown restarts whenever the customer writes again.

EXTENSION.LABEL: Extend adds (minutes)
EXTENSION.HELP: How much time the extend action adds to a single conversation.
